entities.summary: Saffron Revolution, a transformative movement in Myanmar (2007–2011). Emerged from Saffron Revolution — monks lead massive anti-government protests and Aung San Suu Kyi awarded the Nobel Peace Prize while under house arrest. Catalyzed Cyclone Nargis devastates the Irrawaddy Delta, killing over 138,000.
